reply: Not approved. Choice 4 in .kiro/specs/config-get-show/brief.md (point 3 in your message) contradicts the contract section "`get` and `show` (from step 3)". That section says a mapping or list is printed as YAML with "text includes as literal blocks". The brief does not always do this. It prints a text include that has no line break as a one-line scalar, and a literal block can hold that text exactly. It also prints a text include containing CR/CRLF or control characters double-quoted. Both cases put a text include in the YAML output as something other than a literal block, which the contract does not allow. The rest of the choices are not in conflict with the contract.
